tools.name: GlobalBranchesSanitizedSales
tools.summary: Sales totals across all branches in USD, optionally by category, branch or product, with POS training sessions excluded.

python.signature: global_branches_sanitized_sales(db, start_date, end_date, grain='quarter', group_by=None, branch_codes=None, categories=None, include_training=False) -> pandas.DataFrame
python.returns: DataFrame[period: date, <group_by>: str (when set), sales_usd: float, transactions: int]

parameters.name: db
parameters.doc: Database URL (e.g. os.environ['SALES_DB_URL']) or SQLAlchemy engine/connection.

parameters.name: grain
parameters.doc: Bucket size for the period column.

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.doc: Break totals down by this dimension; None returns one row per period.

parameters.name: branch_codes
parameters.doc: Limit to these branches; None means all.

parameters.name: categories
parameters.doc: Limit to these category names; None means all.

parameters.name: include_training
parameters.doc: Keep POS training-session sales (not real revenue).
